sources.title: joshycodes/Qwen3.5-9B-valence-setpoint-plus5-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A research LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B that raises the model's own internal valence representation by a constant +5 standard deviations at every token, while leaving its behavior otherwise close to the base model.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a dense multimodal model from the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks hybrid attention, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP support as its larger siblings, but sized to fit comfortably on a single 24 GB GPU.
